chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"It is appropriate for the Imam's salat (prayer) to be in accordance with the salat (prayer) of the weakest of those behind him."

key_terms.لِلْإِمَامِ: for the Imam who leads the congregational salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: How should an Imam lead congregational salat (prayer) when some followers are weak or unable to endure lengthy prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the Imam leading congregational salat (prayer) should consider the capacity of the weakest follower behind him. It highlights ease, attentiveness to others, and proper conduct in leading communal worship.
